entities.summary: Kim Yong Bok is a North Korean colonel general in command of Korean People's Army Special Operations Forces, and a member of the 7th–8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. He is currently known as the Deputy Chief of the General Staff Department of the Korean People's Army and is closely affiliated with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, having appeared alongside him at multiple military and ceremonial events. He commands key special forces units, including the XI Corps, also known as the "Storm Corps" (폭풍군단), and is believed to lead North Korea's light infantry and reconnaissance deployment operations abroad.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a high-ranking officer in North Korea's military and close associate of Kim Jong Un, Kim Yong Bok plays a significant role in shaping regional security dynamics. His leadership of key special forces units has implications for the country's military capabilities and its relations with neighboring nations.
